contexts: early intervention team with about 210 young people
two part-time peer support workers from January 2027
no research funding beyond the posts
reading: Disengagement in the first six months (claim c4) is what peer support might change, and engagement is where the review found benefit (claim c1). Whether a trial is possible depends on uptake, retention and questionnaire completion, for which a feasibility trial in similar teams gives benchmarks (claim c2). The peer role itself is fragile without clear roles and supervision (claim c3).

nodes.label: Engagement over six months
nodes.detail: Target outcome for a later trial (c1, c4).

nodes.detail: Forty percent leave within a year (c3).
